name: saxo-ai
description: A local-first desktop browser agent with approval before every action.

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && concurrently -k "vite --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts && electron-builder --dir

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: SAXO uses Google Chrome to carry out browser actions only after you approve each action.
